derived_values.used_by: XDidi Index Cloud indicator buffers for long/short signal

other_exits: Opposite signal from XDidi Index Cloud closes existing position before opening reverse

custom_logic_notes: The Didi Index (Indice Didi) is a Brazilian technical indicator created by Odir Aguiar (Didi). It measures the convergence/divergence of moving averages normalized against a reference MA. The 'Cloud' variant renders the area between fast and slow lines as a filled region. The 'Duplex' variant trades both long and short. Signal generation relies on custom indicator buffers (typically 4-6 buffers including up-cloud, down-cloud, fast line, slow line). The exact buffer indices and crossover logic within the cloud determine entries. Since the source file could not be read (binary/encoding issue), some values are inferred from the standard XDidi EA pattern family. The SL/TP and lot values should be verified against the actual source.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Must re-implement the XDidi Index Cloud indicator logic in Python - it is NOT a built-in MT5 indicator. 2) The Didi Index formula: normalize multiple MAs against a reference MA, then compute the 'agulhada' (needle) as the difference of normalized values. 3) The 'Cloud' rendering logic (area between two Didi lines) maps to trading zones - bullish cloud = long zone, bearish cloud = short zone. 4) Entry is typically on crossover of the Didi fast/slow lines or when the cloud changes color/side. 5) The duplex variant reverses position on opposite signal rather than just closing. 6) Digit adjustment for SL/TP must be handled: if _Digits==5 or 3, multiply pip values by 10. 7) New bar detection is used (standard IsNewBar pattern) so signals are evaluated once per completed bar. 8) Since source file was unreadable (binary), recommend obtaining clean .mq5 source to verify all parameter defaults and exact buffer mapping before final conversion.
